fields.location: Claimant for land claims in progress under the Aboriginal Land Rights (Northern Territory) Act 1976. Claims relate to all or part of the claim areas in the following reports by the Aboriginal Land Commissioner: McArthur River Region Land Claim (No. 184) and part of Manangoora Region Land Claim (No. 185); and Lorella Region Land Claim (No. 199) and part of Maria Island Region Land Claim (No. 198). In these reports, the Commissioner made recommendations to the Minister to grant the land claimed.
